Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - There are good readings. *Ταντωνα needs to be flagged up to Trismegistos.* || lin13 <περί τε =PE => περί τε=PN || lin33 PE => PN
Submit - Resubmission with the suggested changes.
Commit - Resubmission incorporating N. Gonis' additional corrections from ZPE 226 (2023) 129 n. 6, and the suggested changes.

Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - Some of the PN (not 'PE') corrections are anticipated in ZPE 226 (2023) 129 n. 6. <:Βαῦ=BL 7.58|ed|(|β̣α̣ν̣|):> also in lin18. Remove "=Original Edition". Please revise and resubmit.
Submit - Resubmission with the same corrections, minus l. 6, where N. Gonis has recently published a correction, + an English translation at the correct section.

Commit - Resubmission with the following corrections: l. 7 ἀλ' ὅμως => ἀλλ᾽ ὅμως; l. 13 περὶ => περί τε; l. 25 (contra BL 7.58) {α̣ὐ̣τὴν} ἡμέραν => τὴν ἡμέραν; l. 33 τ̣α̣ν̣τ̣ω̣ν̣ακαλῶς κεῖται | BL 6.41 τ̣ο̣ύ̣τ̣ω̣ν̣ ἀκαλῶς κεῖται => Ταντωνα καλῶς (monastery of Tantona); l. 34 ὀλιγορήσῃ => ὀλιγωρήσῃ. BL corrections integrated, e.g. l. 21 β̣α̣ν̣ => Βαῦ. I'm also adding an English translation.
